staff.title: Community Owner / Director
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Steward community direction and leadership accountability.
staff.responsibilities: Review governance proposals, appoint authorized leadership, and resolve executive escalations.
staff.training: Set training oversight expectations and review program ownership.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

staff.title: [Executive Leadership Rank TBD]
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Provide executive oversight under a finalized leadership title.
staff.responsibilities: Coordinate senior leadership, review strategic risks, and route governance decisions.
staff.training: Review training program effectiveness and leadership coaching.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

staff.title: [Senior Operations / Management Rank TBD]
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Coordinate community operations above Administrator.
staff.responsibilities: Coordinate administrators, review operational consistency, and consolidate unresolved escalations.
staff.training: Oversee assigned trainers and review recurring training deficiencies.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

staff.title: Administrator
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Support administrative decision review and consistent enforcement.
staff.responsibilities: Review assigned tickets, administrative logs, and escalated staff concerns.
staff.training: Coach Moderators and trainees where specifically authorized.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

staff.title: Moderator
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Support day-to-day member moderation.
staff.responsibilities: Triage assigned tickets, gather context, document actions, and request approval for restricted decisions.
staff.training: Complete required training; mentor only with separate authorization.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

staff.title: Admin-in-Training
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Develop administrative judgment under supervision.
staff.responsibilities: Practice ticket handling, evidence referencing, policy interpretation, and escalation with review.
staff.supervision: No independent supervisory assignment is implied. [SUPERVISORY SCOPE TBD]
staff.training: Complete assigned administrative practice and record corrective coaching.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

staff.title: Staff Trainee
staff.purpose: Proposed draft: Learn the community staff workflow through supervised practice.
staff.responsibilities: Observe approved supervisors, complete orientation and scenarios, and document training questions.
staff.supervision: No independent supervisory assignment is implied. [SUPERVISORY SCOPE TBD]
staff.training: Complete the Staff Training path and supervised field sessions.
staff.restrictions: No implied authority from training completion. [RANK RESTRICTIONS TBD]

leo.title: Major — Administration Only
leo.description: Major is an Administration-only appointment and is not part of standard training or promotional progression.
leo.training: Oversight only as authorized; no training route awards this rank.
leo.scene: Review escalated roleplay operations within Administration-delegated scope.
leo.reporting: Review escalated command reports and governance concerns.

leo.title: Captain
leo.training: Review training records and trainer assignments within [TRAINING APPROVAL LIMITS TBD].
leo.scene: Coordinate complex scene supervision when delegated and route major conflicts to Administration.
leo.reporting: Review department-level summaries and unresolved command concerns.

leo.title: Lieutenant
leo.description: Proposed shift and supervisory coordination role.
leo.training: Review training records and trainer assignments within [TRAINING APPROVAL LIMITS TBD].
leo.scene: Coordinate assigned supervisors across in-game scenes and escalate unresolved issues.
leo.reporting: Review shift reports and route policy questions to Captain or authorized command.

leo.title: Sergeant
leo.training: Review training records and trainer assignments within [TRAINING APPROVAL LIMITS TBD].
leo.scene: Support scene coordination, coaching, and requests for additional command review.
leo.reporting: Review assigned patrol reports and document corrective coaching.

leo.title: Corporal / FTO
leo.description: Proposed experienced officer / trainer role; FTO authority requires separate approval.
leo.training: Document competency evaluations and corrective coaching after [FTO AUTHORIZATION TBD].
leo.scene: Model approved roleplay procedures and supervise assigned training scenarios when authorized.
leo.reporting: Submit FTO evaluations, competency observations, and training deficiencies.

leo.title: Trooper / Officer
leo.training: Complete academy and assigned field training; training alone does not grant supervisory authority.
leo.scene: Participate in in-game calls and traffic stops; request supervisors when outside approved scope.
leo.reporting: Write fictional incident and arrest reports with authorized evidence references.

leo.title: Recruit / Cadet
leo.description: Proposed entry role for supervised academy and field training.
leo.training: Complete academy and assigned field training; training alone does not grant supervisory authority.
leo.scene: Observe and practice assigned ER:LC scenes with an approved trainer.
leo.reporting: Complete training notes and participate in FTO evaluation reviews.
leo.supervision: No independent command implied. [CADET SUPERVISORY SCOPE TBD]
